risk_note: RV2 (content config and switch registry for the CT-25 invite reward; amounts in integer fen, no amount computed). Registers growth.invite_reward.* five config keys after settle.* (amount, daily and total budget, first-order minimum paid: integers 0 to 2147483647, config.business; ip_window_hours 1 to 2147483647, config.risk) and the enabled / payout_paused switches after watch.enabled.<platform> (default false, switch.all, editable, not system written); seeds 1000 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 24 from 08 (switches unseeded, a missing row is off). Guard (orchestrator ruling D10-94 9): turning enabled on needs amount >= 1 fen and both budgets > 0; while on, zeroing any of them is refused on save, batch (whole batch, all zeroed keys listed) and rollback. Both write paths take the same transaction advisory lock per app, then row locks, then read the counterpart keys by full name, so two concurrent requests cannot both succeed. Frozen registry tests accept the group whole or absent since F1-02zm (#977) and F1-02zv (#983); F1-02zt tightens. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
